specialManaEffect.prismatic: Always worth 1 mana more than its own value, regardless of any other modifier active on the card.
specialManaEffect.vital: If you use it to pay for a spell that targets yourself, you recover 2 Health Points. Otherwise it counts as common mana.
specialManaEffect.chaotic: If you use it to pay for a spell that targets your opponent, it deals 2 extra damage. Otherwise it counts as common mana.

manaToken.title: Stored Mana
manaToken.effect: A bit of magical power to use right away. Fades at the end of the turn.

freeze.title: Freeze
freeze.effect: This card has no purpose other than to keep you from drawing useful cards instead. If drawn, it melts at the start of the turn.

playerHud.frozenAria: Frozen: risk of drawing Freeze cards instead of useful ones

handle.desc: 10% chance to duplicate any drawn base element. Socket an element during the match ("Socket" on a base card) to raise it to 20%, but only for that element — every other element drops to no effect.

body.desc: Socket an element during the match ("Socket" on a base card) for protection from it (1 damage nullified) and vulnerability to its opposite (+1 damage).

dark.name: Dark
dark.description: The classic, austere card back, always available to every mage.

light.name: Light
light.description: Its luminous counterpart, always available to every mage.

golden.name: Golden
golden.description: Shines like the most precious metal — reserved for those who have already proven their worth in duel.

books.name: Books
books.description: A collection of arcane tomes, tied to a project outside of Duels.

founder.name: Founder
founder.description: A tribute to those who supported Duels' development from the very beginning.

summer.name: Summer
summer.description: A seasonal card back, available only for a limited time of the year.

archmage.name: Archmage
archmage.description: The mark of one who has learned to cast every spell in the grimoire, at least once.

de-bug.name: de-bug
de-bug.description: Minted for a day of debugging and testing with friends — redeemable only with a code, and only on that date.

friendship.name: Friendship
friendship.description: Two intertwined hearts for those who share the magic of Duels with a friend.

dark-wood.name: Dark wood
dark-wood.description: The dark, rough wood of an ancient circle of mages.

light-wood.name: Light wood
light-wood.description: Its smooth, light-colored counterpart, for a duel by daylight.

burn-wood.name: Burnt wood
burn-wood.description: Wood scorched by the flames of past duels.

slate.name: Slate
slate.description: A cold, silent slab of slate.

golden-fabric.name: Golden fabric
golden-fabric.description: A golden fabric, reserved for those who have already won 50 duels.

felt-fabric.name: Worn felt
felt-fabric.description: A felt worn down by 50 games played.

arcane.name: Arcane
arcane.description: Arcane symbols for those who have already cast 100 spells.

founder.name: Founder
founder.description: A tribute to those who supported Duels' development from the very beginning.

amber.name: Amber
amber.description: An amber backdrop, coming with the autumn season.

profilePage.title: Profile
profilePage.favoriteSpellsEmpty: No spell set as favorite yet. Open the grimoire and select the star icon on the page of the spell you want to mark as favorite.

effects.damageHalveOpponent: Halves the opponent's current hit points.
effects.damageFromFonte: Deals 3 damage to the opponent for each pair of matching advanced elements in the Arcane Source (0-6).
effects.iceClearSelf: Removes all Freeze cards from your own discard pile.
effects.opponentDiscardRandom: The opponent discards {amount} card from their hand.
effects.opponentDiscardHand: The opponent discards their whole hand and draws 5 new cards.
effects.revealOpponentHandRandom: Reveals {amount} random card from the opponent's hand.
effects.revealOpponentHandSpell: Reveals every spell in the opponent's hand.
effects.revealOpponentHandRandomSpell: Reveals {amount} random spell from the opponent's hand (no effect if they have none).
effects.boostCardMana: Permanently increases the mana value of a chosen card from your own discards by {amount}. Fails if the discard pile is empty.
effects.consumeDiscards: Consumes up to {amount} cards chosen from your own discards. No effect if the discard pile is empty.
effects.consumeDiscardsExtended: Consumes up to {amount} cards chosen from your own discards — elements, spells, or effect cards (e.g. Freeze). No effect if the discard pile is empty.

gameSettings.title: Game Settings
gameSettings.confirmText: Are you sure you want to surrender? The game will end immediately.

danger.title: Danger Zone
danger.deleteDesc: Permanently removes your account and all associated data.
danger.confirmText: Are you sure? This action is irreversible. Your account and all your data will be permanently deleted, including any customizations redeemed with a code.
danger.reauthRequired: For security, sign out and sign in again before deleting your account.

fire_bolt.name: Light Burn
fire_bolt.flavorText: Conjuring a fire bolt feels amazing: you can feel the power flowing from your hands and exploding at a distance. Exciting!

water_lance.name: Water Whip
water_lance.flavorText: Have you ever tried launching a jet of water at high speed? You get the same effect as a sword slash, but wetter.

air_slash.name: Air Slash
air_slash.flavorText: You won't even feel it coming, and when it hits, it will make your head spin like you're in a tornado.

earth_shard.name: Earth Shard
earth_shard.flavorText: A shard of earth may seem harmless, but when thrown with force, it can become a deadly projectile. Nature is powerful and unpredictable.

combustion.name: Combustion
combustion.flavorText: Flames multiply upon themselves, in a spiral that feeds on its own heat.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.flavorText: Not a simple fire, but an entire circle of hell crashing down on the target.

flood.name: Flood
flood.flavorText: A wave that leaves no escape, capable of overwhelming any defense.

drowning.name: Tidal Wave
drowning.flavorText: Water tightens around the target like a vice, without leaving a single breath.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.flavorText: A spiral of air that lifts everything in its path, target included.

tornado.name: Tornado
tornado.flavorText: An uncontrollable fury that sweeps away everything in its way.

rockfall.name: Rockfall
rockfall.flavorText: A handful of rocks falls from above, just enough to hurt.

landslide.name: Earthquake
landslide.flavorText: An entire rock face breaks away and crushes everything in its path.

starter_bolt.name: Enchanted Bolt
starter_bolt.flavorText: The first spell every mage learns — simple, yet capable of leaving a mark.

starter_balm.name: Light Healing
starter_balm.flavorText: A flow of magic so pure it restores vigor and closes minor wounds.

mend.name: Healing Dew
mend.flavorText: A damp breeze wraps around the wounds, closing them the way time would — only much faster.

radiant_heal.name: Radiant Heal
radiant_heal.flavorText: A warm glow washes over the skin: the wounds close as if they had never existed.

spore.name: Spore
spore.flavorText: Tiny toxic spores float in the air, silent and patient — just a few breaths are enough for them to take effect.

toxin.name: Toxin
toxin.flavorText: A concentrated dose of pure poison: the kind of gift no opponent truly appreciates.

pestilence.name: Pestilence
pestilence.flavorText: Some spells are so wicked that casting them is almost a crime.

frost.name: Frost
frost.flavorText: A thin layer of ice settles on the target's skin — just a touch is enough to slow them down.

blizzard.name: Freeze
blizzard.flavorText: An icy wind that steals your breath — anyone caught in it feels their limbs stiffen instantly.

ice_age.name: Ice Age
ice_age.flavorText: Time itself seems to stop: it only takes a moment to trap the target in an eternal grip of ice.

protection.name: Stoneskin
protection.flavorText: A scale of fiery rock fuses to the skin, hard as armor.

wall.name: Wall
wall.flavorText: Plates of molten rock rise from the ground, forming a barrier no ordinary blow can scratch.

dissolve.name: Dissolve
dissolve.flavorText: Lava undoes what time has already made useless, lightening the path of those who wield it.

destroy.name: Destroy
destroy.flavorText: Where fire merely melts, this flow leaves nothing left to remember.

aegis.name: Aegis
aegis.flavorText: A legendary defense: lava merges with light itself, forming a shield that seems impossible to break.

spark.name: Spark
spark.flavorText: A small electric jolt, barely noticeable — but enough to pass straight through any shield.

lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightning_bolt.flavorText: A bolt that knows no obstacle: no shield, however solid, can stop it.

thunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm
thunderstorm.flavorText: The sky splits open in a barrage of bolts that no defense can hold back.

black_flame.name: Black Flame
black_flame.flavorText: A flame that burns with darkness: it scorches even the one who casts it, but its target feels it far more.

heat.name: Heat
heat.flavorText: A wave of clean warmth melts away every last trace of ice still lurking among one's own discards.

detox.name: Detox
detox.flavorText: A flow of pure light that sweeps away every trace of poison from the body.

fracture.name: Fracture
fracture.flavorText: A blow so violent it sweeps away any defense in a single instant.

breach.name: Breach
breach.flavorText: A sudden crack runs through the shield, weakening it from within.

black_hole.name: Black Hole
black_hole.flavorText: A void that swallows half the target's life force, leaving no escape.

violent_gust.name: Violent Gust
violent_gust.flavorText: A cutting wind rips a card straight out of the target's hands, carrying it away.

dark_gust.name: Dark Gust
dark_gust.flavorText: A wind tinged with darkness rips two cards from the target's hands, leaving them with precious little to work with.

reset.name: Reset
reset.flavorText: The Arcane Source resets in an instant: the old cards vanish, four new ones take their place.

low_blow.name: Low Blow
low_blow.flavorText: A dirty trick that forces the opponent to get rid of everything in their hand, in a single instant.

third_eye.name: Third Eye
third_eye.flavorText: A furtive glance slips between the opponent's fingers, revealing one of their cards.

supreme_eye.name: Supreme Eye
supreme_eye.flavorText: No secret survives this gaze: the opponent's entire hand lays open like a book.

spell_glimpse.name: Arcane Glimpse
spell_glimpse.flavorText: The gaze ignores common cards and loose mana: it seeks only the spell the opponent is hiding.

risk.name: Risk
risk.flavorText: Whoever casts it never knows what to expect: sometimes nothing happens, sometimes the Arcane Source turns against the unlucky one.

improve_mana.name: Improve Mana
improve_mana.flavorText: A touch of arcane energy that settles permanently on a card, raising its value.
